title: Empty state
summary: What a list shows when it has no rows: an optional icon, a title, a description and the actions that fill it. Densities for a whole page, a panel or a table row.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level exposed to assistive technology.

props.name: announce
props.description: Announce the element politely when it appears (role status), for results that replace a search.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons that fill the empty state.

a11y: Plain text with a heading whose level you choose. Actions are real buttons and links. Set announce when it replaces content after a search or filter so the change is announced politely.

examples.title: With an action
examples.html:
<pk-empty-state heading="No products yet" description="Create your first product to see it here.">
  <pk-button slot="actions">Add product</pk-button>
</pk-empty-state>
